name: MA.mq5
summary: A dual moving average crossover EA that uses a fast 3-period LWMA and a slow 57-period EMA to generate trend-following signals. It enters buy positions when both MAs are rising and price closes above the slow MA, and sell positions when both MAs are falling and price closes below the slow MA, with fixed SL/TP and 5-digit broker adjustment.
summary_zh: 双均线交叉趋势跟踪EA，使用3周期LWMA快线和57周期EMA慢线生成信号。当两均线上升且收盘价在慢线上方时做多，当两均线下降且收盘价在慢线下方时做空，固定止损止盈并支持5位报价经纪商调整。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双均线趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是利用快线(3周期LWMA)与慢线(57周期EMA)的方向一致性和价格相对位置判断趋势。入场条件分为买入和卖出两组：买入需满足慢线连续3根K线上升、快线连续3根K线上升、收盘价高于前一根慢线值、以及慢线在快线之上；卖出条件为慢线连续3根K线下降、收盘价低于前一根慢线值、快线连续3根K线下降、慢线在快线之下。出场条件完全依赖固定止损止盈，止损和止盈均为100点（5位报价自动放大10倍）。仓位管理采用固定手数1.0手，无动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑。该策略仅在新建时执行交易逻辑，使用了新K线检测机制避免重复开仓，同时仅允许单方向持仓。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual moving average trend-following strategy, using the directional consistency of a fast 3-period LWMA and a slow 57-period EMA along with price relative position to identify trends. Buy entry requires four conditions: the slow MA rising for 3 consecutive bars, the fast MA rising for 3 consecutive bars, the close price above the previous slow MA value, and the slow MA above the fast MA. Sell entry mirrors this with declining conditions. Exit relies entirely on fixed stop loss and take profit of 100 points each (auto-adjusted by 10x for 5-digit brokers). Position sizing is a fixed 1.0 lot with no dynamic sizing or money management logic. The strategy only executes on new bars to avoid redundant signals, and it restricts to one position at a time per direction.
pros: 使用新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
支持5位/3位报价经纪商的自动调整，提高止损止盈的准确性
策略逻辑清晰简洁，双均线方向一致性过滤减少假信号
有持仓检测机制，避免同方向重复开仓
pros_en: New bar detection prevents redundant trade entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Automatic 5/3-digit broker adjustment ensures correct SL/TP values across different broker types
Clear and concise strategy logic with dual MA directional consistency filter reduces false signals
Position check mechanism avoids duplicate entries in the same direction
cons: 固定1.0手交易，无资金管理逻辑，对大账户可能风险过高，对小账户可能资金不足
止损止盈1:1风险回报比偏低，趋势跟踪策略通常需要更大盈利空间
ORDER_FILLING_FOK填充模式可能在流动性不足时导致订单被拒绝
未考虑点差过滤，在高点差时段可能产生不利入场
错误处理不完善，OrderSend后仅检查retcode但缺少对部分失败场景的处理
cons_en: Fixed 1.0 lot with no money management logic poses excessive risk for large accounts and insufficient capital for small ones
1:1 risk-reward ratio is suboptimal for trend following which typically needs wider profit targets
ORDER_FILLING_FOK fill mode may cause order rejections during low liquidity periods
No spread filter means entries during high-spread periods may be unfavorable
Error handling is incomplete - OrderSend checks retcode but lacks handling for partial failure scenarios
improvements: 添加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险百分比自动计算交易手数
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免高点差和非活跃时段的不利入场
考虑使用可变止损止盈或移动止损，让趋势跟踪策略有更大的盈利空间
改进订单填充模式，优先使用ORDER_FILLING_IOC并添加重试机制
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance and risk percentage instead of fixed lots
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid unfavorable entries during high-spread or inactive periods
Consider variable SL/TP or trailing stop to give trend-following trades more room for profit
Improve order filling mode by preferring ORDER_FILLING_IOC with a retry mechanism

risk_points: 固定1.0手仓位无资金管理，不同账户规模下风险暴露不可控
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下入场点可能严重偏离预期
仅允许单方向持仓但未使用魔术编号过滤持仓检查，可能与其他EA冲突
risk_points_en: Fixed 1.0 lot without money management leads to uncontrolled risk exposure across different account sizes
No spread filter means entry prices can significantly deviate from expectations in high-spread environments
Single position check without magic number filtering may conflict with other EAs on the same symbol
